question: At the qualified R14 actual-108 state, which of the five phase-anchored context coordinates are globally necessary for nine-entity alias abstraction when exactly one coordinate is omitted from every support tuple?
hypothesis: The phase anchor is the sole globally necessary coordinate in this fixed projection panel: omitting phase_anchor will reproduce the exhaustive unanchored structural collision with eight classes, seven correct alias triplets, zero split entity triplets, and one cross-entity collision pair, while each of the four derived-byte omissions will retain nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.

prior_evidence.observation: All five actual-versus-sham context bytes differed; replacing any single byte in the unique rescuing record removed its exact five-byte support tuple and exactly reproduced the all-sham ten-class, eight-triplet, one-split membership.

scope_statement: This changes one R14 dimension: representation projection rather than local record mutation. The actual-108 stream, selected motifs, seeds, budget, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. Exactly one coordinate is omitted globally in each of five fixed arms. It makes no population, task-learning, or language-competence claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R14 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.leave_one_coordinate_out_arms: Exactly five arms in order [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1]. Each arm uses the identical actual-108 records and omits only its named coordinate from every support tuple; no byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R14 independent seeds; projections introduce no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R14 probe must reproduce five_coordinate_conjunction_supported before R15 output.
The full five-coordinate actual-108 control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
The complete five-arm projection matrix runs once in declared order; every arm uses byte-identical actual-108 records and removes exactly one declared tuple coordinate.
Every arm has 108 records per surface and 2916 total records; projection changes tuple width from five to four and nothing else.
Target selection, entity labels, and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction; labels enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R14 probe reproduces its frozen controls and classification before R15 output.

All five projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records, each projected tuple has width four, and reconstructing each tuple with its omitted source coordinate recovers the source five-byte tuple.
All arms have frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited per evaluated arm.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.phase_only_global_necessity_supported: Validity and controls pass; leave-phase exactly reproduces the frozen eight-class structural collision and all four derived-coordinate omissions exactly retain full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.multiple_coordinates_globally_necessary: Validity and controls pass; leave-phase collides and at least one derived-coordinate omission fails to retain full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.phase_not_globally_necessary: Validity and controls pass; leave-phase retains full-five-coordinate membership.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R14 or full-five-coordinate control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all five fixed projections.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R14 replication, full-five-coordinate control, projection construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R15 output begins, complete all five arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not omit coordinates, add projections, alter tuple construction, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R15 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, coordinate, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R15 output.
